SPEC CORRECTION, train 58 (2026-09-07): this spec previously described SectionIndex's PRE-fix58-detail shape (a bare flex row of middot-separated links, 10.5px/700, `border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)`, `padding:10px 0`). Fix lane fix58-detail (folded into this train; see `sectionindex.json`, already 0 MISMATCH against dc.html #p3's own pill-group markup) restructured SectionIndex into a bordered pill group with a scroll-spy filled active pill — this settings mount uses the SAME component and inherited that redesign automatically, so this spec's stale expect block (10.5px text, middot separator, 10px padding, a bottom border) stopped matching the real render. Re-measured live this session and corrected below to what SectionIndex.tsx (`src/components/detail/DetailShell.tsx`) actually renders: outer `nav.cl-section-index` (`padding:6px 0`, no border, `position:sticky;top:0`), inner pill-group links (`S{n} {label}`, no middot — DetailShell.tsx line ~558, `S{i + 1} {s.label}`, a space not a middot), `font-size:12.5px`, `min-height:44px`, active link filled (`background:var(--brand)`, `color:#fff`, `font-weight:700`) — this fixture's first link (S1) is the active/default one on mount (scroll-spy `active` state starts at index 0).
